content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the PVID (Port VLAN ID) virtual port not being created before the netdevice was registered. This oversight allowed user space applications to configure an IP address on the netdevice before the necessary router interface (RIF) was established, leading to potential misconfigurations and operational issues. The patch corrects this by ensuring the PVID vPort is created prior to the registration of the netdevice.
